notes.title: SUMMER SALE & Underhero 4.1.3 Patch notes!
notes.content:
[i]Beautiful cover art courtesy of [url=https://twitter.com/Yunicorn_corn?s=09]@Yunicorn_corn[/url] [/i]

[h3]Hi there![/h3]

Today is the start of the summer sale and Underhero is [b]50% OFF[/b] for the [b]first time ever![/b] If you still haven't tried it yet, this is the perfect chance to jump into the metaphorical pool known as Underhero. The water is cool, clean, and all  your friends are here drinking smoothies and floating carelessly while you play videogames... in the pool?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28916049/0b1c9e00b084e1e51bfefacafcba48a377dbb742.gif[/img]

We're not particularly sure where we're going with this, so here's the bug fixes for patch 1.4.3

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][list]

[*] The song "Fighting until the very end" was not unlocking for some players.
[*] Left shift key was not working by default for the shield.
[*] Shield default key also not working during the shield tutorial.
[*] Game over menu had a repeating key input that was causing issues with the menu.
[*] Movement keys not working during the ice skating competition by default or with rebinding.
[*] Level up menu couldn't be navigated with D-Pads.
[*] There was a coin getting stuck in the ceiling of the Dark Maze.
[*] W key not working to zoom in the fanart artwork in the fanart room.
[*] During the final battle with [REDACTED], the Masked Kid would get stuck in a falling state when landing in a certain way on platforms. This would in turn, send the player flying through the floor and out of bounds. Yikes.
[/list]

[h3]Also NEW game!?[/h3]

That's right!
We have started to show some of our progress with our new game! Mainly concept art, but we will slowly work our way towards gameplay gifs, trailers, music and more. You can see some of it on our [url=https://twitter.com/papercastledevs/status/1261004045533294592?s=20]Twitter[/url], and we also have a cozy devlog channel in our [url=https://discord.gg/6QZuxHE]discord[/url] server. 

We know you might be thinking this is a sequel, but nope! We are working on an entirely new IP with new characters, gameplay, world, music etc. An Underhero sequel is not entirely discarded, but we want to try new things and improve our skills before we attempt another game in the Underhero universe.

Well that's it for now, if you find any issues be sure to let us know through our [url=https://discord.gg/MZU8RKq]discord server[/url] or here in the Steam forums.

[h3]Thank you for reading, we wish you a happy summer![/h3]

[b]**EDIT**[/b]

[i]Because of unexpected issues with the new patch, we have decided to revert back to version 4.1.2
As soon as we fix the issue we will update to version 4.1.3 once again.[/i]

[b]**EDIT 2**[/b]

[i]4.1.3 is live again, thank you for your patience.[/i]

notes.title: Underhero 4.1.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]

Today we have a more by the numbers update, we mostly fixed some bugs and adjusted a few things.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Swimming bug where the character would jump repeatedly when holding down the jump button with keyboard.
[*] Certain lava switch doing a disappearing act.
[*] Buying things with keyboard unintentionally bought many items at once with one key press.
[*] HUD appearing with every jump when it shouldn't.
[*] Couldn't delete files with keyboard because the "d" key was now back. Whoops.
[*] It was impossible to hide inside the hiding spots in World 5 with keyboard.
[*] Some Elizabeth dialogue prompts not working with keyboard in World 5.
[*] Trying to type a name for a file with a controller connected would cause the "s" and "d" key to respond during typing, and would accept or close respectively.
[*] Issue where drawing tablets were being detected as gamepads, which meant keyboard players would have play with Xbox icon prompts.
[*] Using a forced resolution no longer resets when returning to the main menu.
[*] Cloud saves now working on Linux version.
[/list]

In other news, there is a super cool fan effort right now to mod Underhero and potentially collaborate with the community to create translations for the game! The tool is still in the early testing stages and it might not happen at all mind you, but we are working closely with them to help as much as we can. If you're interested in helping, you can join our discord server below.

Well that's it for now, if you find any issues be sure to let us know through our [url=https://discord.gg/MZU8RKq]discord server[/url] or here in the Steam forums.

[h3]Please hang in there, and thanks for reading![/h3]

notes.title: Underhero 4.1.1 Patch notes (Key binding update!)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

We’re happy to say that with this new update Underhero now has controller remapping and key binding. It took us more work than we originally anticipated, but hopefully it improves the game for more people.

[h3]What's new:[/h3][list]
[*] Completely redone controller menu.
[*] Edit inputs for both keyboards and controllers on the main menu, or during play through the pause menu.
[*] Inputs are saved after the game is closed.
[*] For quick access press "F12" to open the new menu, and "F11" to reset to default inputs.
[*] Most gamepads will be compatible with the game now (no more Xbox exclusivity :P).
[*] This update will also be available for Mac and Linux users.
[*] Quicker saving times, initial loading times slightly faster too.
[*] New force resolution option* (More on this below).
[/list]
Unfortunately we were not able to make it so icons update during play with new inputs, or new icons for different controller types. Regardless of what controller you use the game will still use Xbox 360 icons. We really tried with this one, but it was not possible and we apologize for it. 

This new input system was tested with Xbox 360 controllers, Dualshock 4, Switch Pro controller, generic brand gamepads and keyboards. That said, even after a lot of testing there might be a couple of bugs that slipped through, let us know if you find anything and we will get it fixed for the next patch.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player couldn’t save or load because the save file wasn’t created.
[*] Fixed a couple of lingering typos.
[*] Fixed a bug were the checkered background in some menus would become smaller horizontally when zooming in and closing the menu. 
[*] Other small bugs pertaining to the new input system.
[/list]

[b]*How to access the force resolution option:[/b]

Go to the main menu and then to options, now press “F10” to open the force resolution screen. Type both a new resolution and an aspect ratio and press enter.

This was done in case the game is not recognizing or changing the correct display resolution, it’s a bit hacky but we hope it works for some extreme cases.

If you find any issues be sure to let us know through our [url=https://discord.gg/MZU8RKq]discord server[/url] or here in the Steam forums.

[h3]Please take care, and see you next time![/h3]

notes.title: Mac and Linux now available! Underhero 4.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Underhero 4.1.0 is here![/h1]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mac support
[*] Linux support
[*] Windows 32-bit support
[*] Cloud saves!
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Itormon enemy disappearing after being defeated. This meant the player couldn't talk to it and learn important passwords.
[*] Hilarious bug where Yanijo had [strike]a coconut bikini[/strike] the wrong sprite between being rescued from the volcano, and giving the reward to the player. 
[*] Some W5 Masked Kids had inconsistent names through dialogues.
[*] Blowie enemy wouldn't turn off sleeping particle system if they were bribed while sleeping
[*] Opening and closing the items menu with the B button or the D key wouldn't let the player open the menu again until it was pressed twice.
[*] Attention prompts would still appear on the main menu after quitting the game.
[*] What's Cloning On wouldn't spawn.
[*] And other smaller issues.
[/list]

[h3]What's up with the new controller options:[/h3]

We are currently still working out the kinks of key binding and controller remapping for the game, but we are close! We've had to rework quite a few things in order to let any type of gamepad and keyboard be compatible with the game. New updates for the Unity engine have thrown a few curve balls our way, we still need to figure out a few things. Hang in there!

Here's a sneak peek of the reworked controllers menu (keep in mind that is a work in progress and some things might change!):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28916049/0e25b2010869b5100107cab93bdcfb97d08f8f98.png[/img]


[h2]That's it for today, tell your Mac and Linux friends that Underhero is now ready for them![/h2]

We would also like to remind you that Underhero will release for Switch, PS4, and Xbox One next week! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/573320/announcements/detail/1691599820059759782]Read all about it here.[/url]

If you find any bugs or problems be sure to let us know through our [url=https://discord.gg/MZU8RKq]discord server[/url] or here in the Steam forums.

notes.title: Underhero 4.0 is here!
notes.content:
Hello again!

We've been hard at work porting the Underhero source code to a newer version of the Unity engine as to make console ports possible and improve the game on PC as well. This brought a great deal of new bugs and things that needed to be adapted to the new version, needless to say it took a lot of time, but...

We are happy to announce that the update is now live!

There are way too many changes and improvements to the overall performance of the game to count, so here's a general idea of the things that we have fixed:

- Resolution options are back and (hopefully) working as intended this time.
- We have added a V-Sync toggle in the options menu.
- Improved collisions and character controls.
- The bugged achievements "Almost untouchable" and "Key finding master" have been fixed, now "Employee of the month!" can be completed 100%.
- On that note, those who completed these achievements should automatically have them when they load their save file in game.
- Stutter issues and occasional framerate drops have been addressed and improved (We are still unsure if this is fixed for some Nvidia users, time will tell.)
- Improved camera follow methods.
- Final battle music cutting off on right and left headphones.
- Improved horizontal and vertical moving platforms.
- Infinite stamina recharge animation bug fixed.
- You can now return to World 4 after finishing it.
- Enemy Masked Kids shield bugs.
- Baron van Gregory Boss fight performance.
- And many more technical/small bugs.

If you find any new bugs don't hesitate to tell us through our [url=https://discord.gg/CbBr4yW] Discord server [/url]  or the Steam forums.
Don't be alarmed if you see new updates from now on, we'll be fixing any bugs that pop up.

Thank you for the patience!

notes.title: Art Book & Updates 2019
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy new year everyone![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since our last update so we wanted to let you know what we've been up to lately and what are our plans for the future.

[h1][b]- Underhero Art Book:[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28916049/c1726c4d29534a30fa2fa9643d79ace63249dc7c.png[/img]

That's right, we made a book that collects all the concept art and design for Underhero, it has more than 70 pages of sketches, designs, unseen art and more!

[h1][url=https://twitter.com/Underherodevs/status/1083416669731647494]We are currently running a give-away for the book on our twitter, head over there for a chance to win a key for the book and the game![/url][/h1]

It's also available for purchase on these sites:

[url=https://papercastlegames.itch.io/underhero-art-book]Itchio[/url]
[url=https://gumroad.com/l/uhart]Gumroad[/url]

[h1][b]- Underhero Soundtrack:[/b][/h1]

You may have noticed that the soundtrack is not yet available on Steam, we did all we could to have everything ready for launch but because of complications with the publisher of the Underhero Soundtrack we haven't been able to offer it here on Steam.

We are still trying to resolve this issue and we want nothing more than to have it available as soon as possible, but for now the soundtrack is also available on these other sites:

[url=https://stijnvanwakeren.bandcamp.com/album/underhero-original-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url] 
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/underhero-original-game-soundtrack/1438049750]iTunes[/url] 
[url=https://open.spotify.com/album/0OJZ14tJo31K5sN8RqTqfz?si=xi4tP1qrRBeIeyWL6XIu2Q]Spotify[/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/music/album/Stijn_van_Wakeren_Underhero_Original_Game_Soundtra?id=B2rx7rtvkgscytkotabq7jcd5vu]Google Play[/url]
[url=https://www.amazon.fr/Underhero-Original-Soundtrack-Stijn-Wakeren/dp/B07HJ8SP8B]Amazon[/url]

[h1][b]- Game updates:[/b][/h1]

We are extremely aware of the current bugs and problems with the game's current build, we haven't stopped working and improving the game ever since it was released.

But because we started working on this game on 2013, we have been using an older version of the Unity engine which has caused a lot of compatibility issues. So we decided this past November to upgrade the game to the latest version of Unity 2018. 

This was not an easy task, porting the game has come with it's fair share of problems, but we believe this will help us improve the game for the better.

We are on the testing and debugging phases so we plan to release the new update in the upcoming months, please bear with us while we work on it!

[h1][b]- Console ports:[/b][/h1]

The other big reason for the Unity 2018 update is that it was necessary if we wanted to port the game to all the current game consoles, unfortunately we have nothing to announce at the moment, but we are definitely working towards this goal!

I believe that's it for now, thanks for reading and if you have any questions let us know below or chat with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/Wfcbj3d]official Discord server.[/url]

notes.content:

[h1]Mr. Stitches:[/h1] Hello, my dear children.

It has come to my attention that some of you enjoy making fanart of our little game. So I, Mr. Stitches, Lord of Darkness, and other grim titles, have decided to hold a fanart contest!

Let’s discuss how this will work, so pay attention! You lovely scum, you.

[url=https://discord.gg/ukNrGV5]1st- Join our Discord server here![/url] 

And enter the channel called #fanart-contest.

[h1]2nd- Upload a file of your fanart![/h1]

That’s right, a file.
This fanart contest is not just for drawings; it’s for music, fan fiction, handmade crafts, cosplay, fan games, videos, you name it!

[h1]3rd- I, Lord Stitches, will choose 6 winners:[/h1]

The first 3 winners will be chosen from the best of the best, truly recognized for their effort and creativity.
The other 3 winners will be chosen after the first three, and they will be chosen at random!
So it doesn’t matter what artistic level you have, everyone has a chance of winning!

[b]Disclosure: We will only accept ONE piece of fanart per person, so pick your favorite and send it!
No cheating or I W I L L K N O W.[/b]

[h1]4th- The glorious prizes:[/h1]

I will bestow upon the winners a key for Underhero, in their platform of choice (Steam or Gamejolt, Windows PC only!). I will let my goons contact the winners privately through discord. They are lazy, but not even they can ignore my orders. HAHAHA!

And for the second super special prize…

Your art, forever immortalized inside the code of Underhero.
It will be hidden in a secret room. I hope you find it! (We will add this room in an update, after launch).

The contest starts today, so you can start sending that sweet fanart NOW, until September 15. That day will be the end of the contest.

The next day on September 16, the winners will be announced!

And even if you don’t win, we still have a little surprise for all the contestants…

[h1]That same day, we will update the Underhero demo![/h1]

So there you go, no one is allowed to complain now.

I bid you farewell for now, my underlings…
If you have any questions, you can reach my lackeys through twitter, discord, or the comments section below.

notes.title: Big update! New things! Journals! And 2018!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28916049/281ce528b6d9e265cfaf10f186ba7935e83df07f.gif[/img]

[i]Up and down and all around~[/i] 

Ok! Let’s review (in no particular order) the things we have fixed and added to the game recently:
[list]
[*]You can now exit the game after a checkpoint without fear of losing your progress! [b]But only if you press "Continue" on the main menu. Using "load" will restart you at your last save station.[/b] Think of checkpoints as soft saves, and save stations as hard saves from now on.
[*]Remember those little hiccups after you saved or passed through a checkpoint? [b]Gone.[/b]
[*]You can now bribe enemies right from the get go, instead of attacking first.
[*]We now have a pretty loading screen!
[*]Added skip options for all tutorials.
[*]Some conversations with Elizabeth are optional now. If you don’t want to hear what she has to say you can just ignore her (you monster).
[*]You can use keyboard and controllers at the same time now.
[*]We added a traveling merchant for certain places! They will sell useful stuff like magic anvils, potions and other things! 
[*]Fixed many bugs, like, you wouldn’t believe.
[/list] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28916049/87277508669724558855f69e456d03fe4a9de1d3.png[/img]

[h1][b]And last but not least, we have added a handy journal for your adventure![/b][/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28916049/789923a965a82f22dd5a52e16fd60ac7e43f1ab2.png[/img]

You will be able to check your journal and see how your adventure is going:
[list] 
[*]Stopped playing for a few days and forgot what you were doing? Journal!
[*]Want to know what the protagonist thinks of the adventure so far? Journal!
[*]Forgot about some side quest and want a quick reminder? You guessed it!
[/list] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28916049/786cc3ad06e3a707b7090090439d77b0826a0aee.png[/img]

And yes, the main character writes! [i]Being quiet doesn’t mean you can’t talk somehow.[/i]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]That’s it for today![/b][/h1]

We wanted to talk about more stuff, but I think it’s better if we discuss it a little more in the upcoming updates.

There’s still a lot of work ahead of us, but we are getting [b]closer and closer.[/b]
So please, be patient! We want you to play this thing as much as you, but the game still requires more testing, work and polish.

A 2017 release is no longer possible (even after doing everything we could). [b]We are now aiming for early 2018![/b]

[i]See you next time![/i]
